Author: Rayla Petal
Name: Corruption
Description:
Earn XP and arousal when you and a nearby player with the plugin both play animations from mods you each picked in Penumbra. Level through corruption tiers, climax into Cummy layers, bond with a regular partner, earn and wear titles, spend Sins in the shop, and opt into a full pregnancy system. Everything runs locally.
Requires Penumbra, SimpleHeels and a sync service such as Lightless. Cummy, Glamourer, Moodles and Intiface Central are optional. 18+ content.
Punchline: Earn corruption with someone nearby while your animations play.
Changelog:
- Titles: unlock them from levels, prestige and achievements, or buy some in the shop. Wear one from Profile: it shows over your nameplate (above the text, below your name, or off) and gives a small bonus that suits it. It can't change during a scene.
- Tiered achievements (Insatiable II and III and more) and four hidden ones.
- Ten new goals. You're only given goals you can meet.
- Moon events from Eorzea's moon: a Full Moon speeds arousal, and a New Moon pays more Sins for scene time.
- A summary popup when a scene ends, and the last scene on Profile.
- Partner history and titles on Nearby, with a list of past partners.
- Popups for new tiers and titles.
- The shop is grouped into sections.
- The integrations now show in a footer on every page.
